_doc: Enforcement-parity ledger (ADR-034). Every audit finding must exit via one of: test | ci | guard | waiver. exit.type='open' entries age against severity SLAs (high=30d, medium=60d, low=90d from 'filed'). scripts/ledger_check.py fails CI on delinquent entries. Waivers require 'expires' and 'reason'; an expired waiver is delinquent. Do NOT close a finding by deleting it — set its exit and keep the row.

findings.summary: Unauthenticated POST /api/compass calls the Anthropic API with no rate limit — wallet-drain/abuse vector.

exit.ref: src/lib/ratelimit.ts wired into src/app/api/compass/route.ts (interim in-memory limiter)

findings.summary: Durable, cross-instance rate limiting + spend caps + LLM observability via Vercel AI Gateway (replaces RL-001 interim limiter; also covers /api/brief and /api/guide Claude calls).

exit.reason: Deferred by Zach 2026-09-28: AI Gateway rate limiting + spend caps rescheduled; RL-001 interim limiter stays in place meanwhile.

findings.summary: Trust contract §3 promises account deletion within 30 days but no implemented deletion path existed.
Trust contract §1 (anonymous sessions write nothing server-side) has no regression test — the exact defect disclosed in §1 could silently recur.
src/lib/ygate.ts (core scoring algorithm, pure function) has zero unit tests.
CI lint is advisory (continue-on-error); no lint rule prevents className/Tailwind recurrence after the 2026-07-11 removal.
No exception tracking on the app (SageTrace exposure was detected via a vendor email, not our own alerting).

exit.reason: Deferred by Zach 2026-09-28: error-tracking vendor choice tabled one month (new dependency decision).

findings.summary: No automated dependency vulnerability scanning.
DATABASE_URL manually set, rotation risk open since ADR-005 amendment (2026-05-28).

exit.reason: Requires Zach to rotate the Supabase password and re-sync Vercel envs — not executable by a session alone.

findings.summary: Production DB backup restore has never been tested — an unrestored backup is a hope, not a backup.

exit.reason: Deferred by Zach 2026-09-28: restore drill not scheduled this cycle.

findings.summary: Trust contract §2 'aggregate anonymized only' modeling claim has no code boundary enforcing it (purpose limitation is prose-only).

exit.ref: scripts/purpose_guard.py (ci.yml smoke: Purpose-limitation guard). Binds the live claims (trust §2 'input never trains a model', privacy 'no decision text' in analytics): no non-Anthropic model SDK or third-party analytics under src/, track() payload keys allowlisted. The 'aggregate anonymized only' wording no longer appears on any public page.

findings.summary: Orphaned Supabase tables (meeting_cards/risks/raci/etc.) with no owning app; 4 advisor WARNs deliberately unfixed (backlog #13/#14).

exit.ref: Migrations drop_orphaned_prototype_tables + rls_deny_all_profileupload (2026-07-18): all 8 tables verified empty + zero code refs in arcs-v9/arcs-care, dropped with Zach's approval; ProfileUpload RLS ERROR (post-ADR-008 table, SageTrace defect class) fixed same pass. Advisor now 0 ERROR / 1 WARN.

findings.summary: Legacy arcs-care 'sessions' table has an anon INSERT policy (WITH CHECK true) — open write surface on an inactive product; last remaining advisor WARN. Decide: drop the legacy arcs-care tables (sessions/waitlist) or tighten the policy.

exit.ref: Supabase xbbpiryokswwvcrcutge: dropped anon/authenticated INSERT and SELECT policies on public.sessions; RLS now leaves only service_role SELECT (verified via pg_policies)

findings.summary: public/arcs_recoil_canvas.py + public/arcs_recoil_philosophy.md were served world-readable by filename on every arcs.care host (same exposure class as the 2026-07-24 war-room HTML move). canvas.py hardcoded real Fanatics counterpart names + private per-person assessments + recoil stop-loss/NCI method; philosophy.md is the internal Forensic Cartography method doctrine. The J24 leak_check only scanned public/*.html, so these non-HTML source/doc files slipped the gate.

exit.ref: Both files git-mv'd public/ -> runtime/recoil/ (unserved). scripts/leak_check.sh hardened with a stray-source gate that fails CI on any *.py/*.md directly under public/, closing the recurrence class.

findings.summary: Receipt Studio (/api/receipts/studio/[tenant]): the sessionId bearer now grants WRITE (PATCH close/score), not just READ, and travels in the GET query string (?sessionId=), so a Referer/proxy-log/history leak is a write capability. Accepted for the robin tenant (Zach's own demo receipts, non-attributable). CISO review finding B, 2026-08-07.

exit.reason: Blast radius is one non-sensitive demo tenant. MUST NOT generalize to a user-attributable/sensitive tenant without moving the token to a header/cookie or a POST body. Re-review before onboarding any such tenant.

findings.summary: In-memory per-instance throttle Map on the studio route (and its louisville precedent) is bounded only by instance lifetime x unique IPs — a rotating-IP scraper can grow it. SRE review finding F3, 2026-08-07.

exit.ref: Both anon routes now opportunistically evict expired entries when hits.size>5000: src/app/api/receipts/studio/[tenant]/route.ts and src/app/api/louisville/receipts/route.ts throttled(). Bounded.

findings.summary: Historical prepId IDOR exposure (pre-#830): receipts may link a prep owned by another user. One-off SQL to find receipts whose prepId's prep is linked to receipts of >1 userId; null links and review as possible exposure. CISO review on #830, 2026-10-05.

exit.ref: Guard: #830 (d9f8af71) scopes the prepId lookup to its owner. Prod audit 2026-10-05 (read-only): 35 receipts linked to 29 preps, 0 owner mismatches, 1 prep shared across users (cmqehi71r...): founder account on 2026-06-15, then a signed-out run on 2026-06-26, which Zach confirmed was him. Stray link cleared (Receipt cmquhy89w... prepId set to null). No external exposure.

findings.summary: Dashboard recovery poll (src/app/dashboard/page.tsx ~242) polls with the sent session id; if /api/compass re-minted it (foreign thread), the saved receipt is not found and the stale id is re-stored. Clear arcs_session_id when server id differs, or 409 before inference. CISO review, 2026-10-05.

exit.ref: /api/compass returns 409 code=session_reassigned before inference when it would re-mint a client sessionId; src/app/dashboard/page.tsx clears arcs_session_id and re-runs once as a fresh thread, so no receipt is ever persisted under an id the client did not see.

findings.summary: src/app/api/receipts/claim/route.ts lets any signed-in user holding a session id claim every unowned legacy row in that thread. Bind to a server-issued HttpOnly token or retire once legacy rows are gone. CISO review, 2026-10-05.

exit.ref: Route retired in ee710d35 (PR #847): src/app/api/receipts/claim/route.ts deleted; no in-repo caller remains (ClaimAnonymousReceipts.tsx only runs the ADR-049 opt-in save). No anonymous receipt persisted since 2026-07-13, so nothing new is claimable.

findings.summary: /api/compass, /api/receipts/save, /api/prep parse bodies by hand (no Zod); non-string entity in /api/prep 500s on .trim(). Add safeParse with length caps like the guide route. CISO review, 2026-10-05.

exit.ref: Zod envelopes in src/lib/request-schemas.ts (CompassBody, PrepBody, SaveBody) used by /api/compass, /api/prep, /api/receipts/save; thread ids must be UUIDs (isThreadId, via resolveOwnedSessionId). tests/unit/request-schemas.test.ts covers the non-string-entity 500 and the dashboard/prep payload shapes.

findings.summary: /api/health?deep=1 compares the CRON_SECRET bearer with === (not constant-time). Use crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers. CISO review of PR #877, 2026-10-05.
/api/annotations/meditate and /api/annotations/[id]/shavasana call Haiku with no rate limit (session-gated only). Add rateLimit() like brief/guide. CISO review of PR #877, 2026-10-05.
